name: @projexlight/hdk-camera
summary: Native camera capture for ProjexCloud's HDK — JS bindings for iOS + Android + desktop Electron camera devices. Captures still photos, short videos, and burst sequences with EXIF geo-stamp + tamper-evident attestation (device key signs the source bytes at capture time). Each capture lands in sdk-evidence with the chain-of-custody root row already attested. Powers field-service proof-of-work, healthcare lesion photos, and claims-intake FNOL flows.

endpoints.description: Returns supported devices (front / rear / depth / IR) + format (jpeg / heic / dng / mp4) per platform.
Returns tenant-allowed recording presets (resolution / bitrate / max-duration). Used by mobile UI to constrain capture.

events.name: hdk.camera.capture.v1
events.description: Photo / video captured. Carries device_uuid + capture_persona + geo (lat/lng/accuracy) + source_hash + device_attestation_signature.

events.name: hdk.camera.attestation.failed.v1
events.description: Device attestation failed (jailbroken / rooted device, signing key revoked). Capture refused at source.

events.name: hdk.camera.preset.applied.v1
events.description: Recording preset selected for a capture session.

hooks.name: capturePhoto
hooks.description: Universal entry. Returns { blob, exif, attestation_signature }. Caller hands the bundle to sdk-evidence.registerCapture.

hooks.name: captureVideo
hooks.description: Video variant with max-duration enforcement per the tenant's recording-preset policy.

hooks.name: captureBurst
hooks.description: Burst sequence (e.g. 5 frames @ 1 fps). Each frame separately attested.

hooks.name: probeAttestation
hooks.description: Returns whether the device is trusted (signing key present + not revoked, not on a rooted/jailbroken device). UI uses this to disable capture on untrusted devices.

ui_components.name: CameraView
ui_components.description: Native-rendered camera preview with capture button. Themed via @projexlight/design-system.

ui_components.name: AttestationBadge
ui_components.description: Tiny status badge showing the device's trust state; tenant policy can refuse captures when red.

scenarios.title: Field tech captures a proof-of-work photo with geo-stamp + attestation
scenarios.when_to_use: End-of-job confirmation on the tech's mobile app. Photo, geo, attestation all bundled in one capture call.
scenarios.expected_outcome: sdk-evidence row created with the attestation signature already attached. Adjudication trail starts attested from the source bytes outward.

scenarios.title: Clinician captures a skin-lesion photo via the patient portal
scenarios.when_to_use: Tele-health visit; clinician needs a high-quality lesion image. Native bindings give better quality + control than browser <input type='file'>.
scenarios.expected_outcome: HEIC photo at maximum sensor resolution. PHI tier enforced at the next step (sdk-evidence + sdk-vault encrypt under the tenant's PHI key).

scenarios.title: Customer captures a 5-frame burst for the FNOL form
scenarios.when_to_use: Insurance claim from the customer's phone — multiple angles of the damage in one tap.
scenarios.expected_outcome: 5 separately-attested frames. Each becomes a sdk-evidence capture; UI shows the burst grouped under the same FNOL submission.

scenarios.title: Capture refused on jailbroken / rooted device
scenarios.when_to_use: Tenant policy demands trusted-device-only capture (e.g. finserv chain-of-evidence). probeAttestation returns false; capture endpoint refuses; UI shows the trust-state badge red.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Untrusted device blocked at capture. Emits hdk.camera.attestation.failed.v1 with the reason. UI explains the refusal to the user.

scenarios.title: Tenant restricts video captures to ≤ 30s 720p
scenarios.when_to_use: Storage / bandwidth cost control on free-tier tenants. Recording-preset policy enforced in the native layer so the cap can't be bypassed in the JS bridge.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Capture honors the preset. Tenant admin can relax / tighten via the policy update — instantly reflected in the next session via the recording-presets endpoint.

compliance_posture.notes: Device-attestation signature at capture is the FRE 902(13) self-authentication lever — adjudicators don't need a chain-of-custody witness to admit the image because the device key signed the source bytes. ISO 27037 evidence-handling met by source_hash + attestation_signature + geo all bundled in the capture event.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per photo/video/burst captured (free up to plan ceiling)
per attestation probe (signal of mobile-app activity)
